goal: Improve one weapon through a reusable focused fixture, then integrate once at a declared checkpoint.

player_outcome.control: fires, reloads, aims, and changes viewing angle
player_outcome.threat: a representative close and mid-range target
player_outcome.feedback: sees and hears weapon state, shot direction, impact, and reload completion
player_outcome.outcome: can predict the weapon state and understand every shot and reload result

constraints.asset_policy: original or licensed shipped assets only
scope: one reusable weapon fixture and one whole-path integration checkpoint
out_of_scope: unrelated level traversal and campaign content
accessibility: critical weapon state is not encoded by colour alone

quality_dimensions.label: Assets and modeling
quality_dimensions.rationale: This bounded run changes weapon behavior and presentation, not model topology or authored asset scope.

quality_dimensions.label: Materials, shaders, and lighting
scope: weapon presentation in canonical fixture views
quality_dimensions.rationale: Weapon presentation can be weakened by material or lighting changes and must remain reviewable.

quality_dimensions.label: Motion and VFX
scope: fire, recoil, reload, muzzle, and impact feedback
quality_dimensions.rationale: The player outcome depends on temporal and visual action feedback.

quality_dimensions.label: UI and UX
quality_dimensions.rationale: This example makes no HUD layout or interaction-flow claim.

quality_dimensions.label: Interaction, camera, and physics
scope: shipping fire and reload input, canonical views, hit response
quality_dimensions.rationale: The scenario exercises the real input and hit paths from decisive views.

quality_dimensions.label: Gameplay, levels, and AI
scope: weapon state behavior and representative encounter integration
quality_dimensions.rationale: The weapon must remain usable inside the representative player path.

quality_dimensions.label: Balance, economy, and progression
quality_dimensions.rationale: The run makes no comparative damage, economy, or progression claim.

quality_dimensions.label: Narrative and content
quality_dimensions.rationale: No narrative beat or content-cohesion claim is part of this run.

quality_dimensions.label: Audio
scope: fire, empty, reload, and impact cues
quality_dimensions.rationale: The player outcome explicitly depends on hearing weapon state and consequence.

quality_dimensions.label: Learning and replay
scope: predictable weapon state and understandable action result
quality_dimensions.rationale: The declared outcome requires the player to predict state and understand every result.

quality_dimensions.label: Accessibility and localization
scope: weapon state feedback that does not depend on colour alone
quality_dimensions.rationale: The run contract includes an explicit non-colour accessibility constraint.

quality_dimensions.label: Correctness, data, and lifecycle
scope: ammo accounting, reset, reload, hit state, and integration lifecycle
quality_dimensions.rationale: Deterministic state and reset behavior are required for valid evidence.

quality_dimensions.label: Performance and stability
quality_dimensions.rationale: The accepted candidate must not destabilize the representative player path.

quality_bar.comparison: One focused run exposes fire, reload, empty-magazine, multi-angle, and multi-direction behavior for independent review.
quality_bar.inspect_route: scenario_weapon_fixture artifact bundle, followed by scenario_weapon_integration only at an integration checkpoint
limits: The focused fixture does not prove whole-game cohesion or target-player fun.

scenarios.purpose: Exercise one parameterized weapon without loading or manually traversing the main scene.
scenarios.player_question: Are firing, reload, state transitions, direction, and presentation correct from all decisive views?

ownership.shipping_surface: weapon runtime, animation, VFX, audio, camera feedback, and hit reporting
ownership.public_adapter: weapon_id parameter plus normal equip, fire, reload, aim, and camera APIs

fixture.reuse_scope: all weapons implementing the public weapon contract
fixture.extension_contract: register a new weapon_id and expected data; do not fork the fixture or duplicate weapon logic

setup.entry: launch the weapon fixture directly with weapon_id
setup.state: known magazine, reserve ammo, targets, lighting, camera anchors, and clean temporal state
setup.camera_or_view: scripted first-person, side, rear, muzzle, and target views

stimulus.action: fire one normal shot through the shipping input path
fire a controlled sequence from multiple aim directions
reload from a partially used magazine
empty the magazine, attempt fire, then reload
move through canonical camera anchors without restarting the scene

observations.window: canonical views at fire and reload phases

observations.source: timestamped animation, audio, VFX, recoil, and hit events

coverage_matrix.state: partial magazine followed by empty magazine

execution_policy.case_isolation: reset weapon, target, camera, decals, particles, audio, and clocks between in-scene cases
extra_launch_triggers: a failure corrupts later in-scene cases
strict temporal isolation cannot be guaranteed

determinism.warmup: load resources without advancing weapon state
determinism.temporal_isolation: clean fixture process plus explicit in-scene case reset

fast_review_route.command: project-specific direct weapon fixture command with weapon_id

strict_regression_route.command: project-specific isolated weapon fixture command with assertions
strict_regression_route.isolation: fresh process, fixed viewport, seed, tick, subject parameter, and artifact directory

scenarios.reset: discard fixture-local state and start from the declared weapon_id and seed
failure_conditions: fixture bypasses the shipping weapon path
a coverage case or declared viewpoint is absent
an extra launch occurs without a declared trigger
limitations: Whole-game cohesion is evaluated only by the integration scenario.

scenarios.purpose: Check the accepted weapon candidate once in the representative player path.
scenarios.player_question: Does the accepted weapon still work and cohere inside the real player path?

ownership.shipping_surface: main player path and shared runtime contracts
ownership.public_adapter: normal main-scene entry plus scripted representative player actions

fixture.reuse_scope: accepted weapon candidates at declared integration checkpoints
fixture.extension_contract: reuse the player-path driver; vary only weapon_id and declared encounter seed

setup.entry: launch the representative player path at a declared integration checkpoint
setup.state: known encounter state with the accepted weapon equipped

stimulus.action: perform the normal player path including fire, reload, movement, hit, and recovery

observations.source: runtime assertions, bounded capture, and performance trace

coverage_matrix.state: accepted weapon candidate in representative encounter
assertions: weapon feedback coheres with player path

execution_policy.case_isolation: fresh process and clean integration seed
extra_launch_triggers: the integration run is invalid because the environment or capture rig failed

determinism.warmup: load the representative path before starting the observation window
determinism.temporal_isolation: fresh process and clean integration state

strict_regression_route.isolation: fresh process, fixed subject, seed, viewport, and artifact directory

scenarios.reset: discard integration state and relaunch only after a declared trigger
failure_conditions: integration route cannot reach the representative path
shared contract or frozen gate regresses
main scene is relaunched without a declared checkpoint or invalid-run trigger
limitations: One bounded integration path does not prove target-player fun.

run_after: focused gates pass for an accepted candidate
shared contracts or composition root change

quality_gates.claim: Fire, reload, empty-magazine, direction, and hit state use the shipping weapon path correctly.
assertions: state transitions and ammo accounting pass

quality_gates.claim: Weapon action remains legible and coherent from every declared review viewpoint.
assertions: animation, audio, VFX, recoil, and impact agree with the state trace

quality_gates.claim: The accepted weapon candidate remains correct and cohesive in the representative whole player path.
assertions: shared contracts and affected frozen gates remain valid

ownership.surface: weapon implementation plus dedicated development fixture
ownership.public_contract: weapon data and normal equip, fire, reload, aim, camera, and hit interfaces

ownership.surface: main player path, shared contracts, and composition root
